summary: The filing is a prospectus supplement for Curbline Properties Corp. (a REIT) registering up to $400 million of common stock for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. It replaces a prior ATM agreement and details sales through agents or forward sale agreements. No specific price per share, premium, or timeline is provided; the offering is continuous and at prevailing market prices. There is no merger, tender offer, or other special-situation event. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
